fields.name: image
fields.label: Image

fields.name: amount_min
fields.label: Minimum loan amount (₹)
fields.description: Numbers only, e.g. 100000. Must not be more than the maximum.

fields.name: amount_max
fields.label: Maximum loan amount (₹)
fields.description: Numbers only, e.g. 10000000. Must not be less than the minimum.

fields.name: amount_default
fields.label: Default loan amount (₹)
fields.description: Starting value. Must be between the minimum and maximum, otherwise the nearest limit is used.

fields.name: amount_step
fields.label: Slider step (₹)
fields.description: How much one slider move changes the value, e.g. 10000. Must be more than 0 and no more than the range.

fields.name: rate_min
fields.label: Minimum interest rate (%)
fields.description: Numbers only, e.g. 8. Must not be more than the maximum.

fields.name: rate_max
fields.label: Maximum interest rate (%)
fields.description: Numbers only, e.g. 24. Must not be less than the minimum.

fields.name: rate_default
fields.label: Default interest rate (%)
fields.description: Starting value. Must be between the minimum and maximum, otherwise the nearest limit is used.

fields.name: rate_step
fields.label: Slider step (%)
fields.description: How much one slider move changes the value, e.g. 0.1. Must be more than 0 and no more than the range.

fields.name: tenure_min
fields.label: Minimum tenure (years)
fields.description: Numbers only, e.g. 1. Must not be more than the maximum.

fields.name: tenure_max
fields.label: Maximum tenure (years)
fields.description: Numbers only, e.g. 7. Must not be less than the minimum.

fields.name: tenure_default
fields.label: Default tenure (years)
fields.description: Starting value. Must be between the minimum and maximum, otherwise the nearest limit is used.

fields.name: tenure_step
fields.label: Slider step (years)
fields.description: How much one slider move changes the value, e.g. 1. Must be more than 0 and no more than the range.
